references.text: A voice cries out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight! This relates to John the Baptist's role and mission, as mentioned in Matthew 3:11.
I have baptized you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit. This verse from Mark reflects John the Baptist's words in Matthew 3:11 about baptism with the Holy Spirit.

John answered them all: I baptize you with water. But one who is more powerful than I is coming, and I am not worthy to untie the strap of his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire. This verse from Luke directly echoes the message in Matthew 3:11.

For John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days after this. This verse from Acts points to the promise of baptism with the Holy Spirit mentioned in Matthew 3:11.
Then I remembered the Lord's words: 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.' This verse from Acts refers back to John the Baptist's words in Matthew 3:11.

Paul said: John baptized with a baptism of repentance and told the people to believe in the one who was coming after him, that is, in Jesus. This verse from Acts refers to John the Baptist's role and message as mentioned in Matthew 3:11.
